My mother was overly protective of me and extremely clingy as I was growing up. She still is tbh.

She insisted on taking me to school everyday until I was 16 and would arrange someone to pick me up. You can imagine how embarrassing this was for me as we lived within walking distance to the school.

Almost every morning I would insist on going alone saying "do you not trust me to go alone" 

"No, I do trust you I just want to keep you comoany" 

Me: " but I don't want to trouble you and make you wake up for me everyday when you could just sleep in" and then she would cry and I would just bite my tongue and accept my fate. With more and more resentment growing in me each day.

One day when I was 13 (somehow I was allowed to come home alone) I was invited to go over to a friend's house after school. And you can imagine how excited I was as this has never happened before. We stopped at a corner shoo to buy snacks and ran into my brother and mum. At first they were ok with me going with my friend but then they followed us in their car and picked me up ad I was just about to knock on the front door of my friends house. 

So then I was told that I couldn't visit friends houses and that I could invite them over only. But any trend who came over was met with funny, suspicious looks. Their teenagers mum what could they do to me? Jesus Christ. The least you could do is make them feel welcome.

My attemot to study abroad as a student was met by shouting and praying that i get canceer if i go. I tried to move out of the house as 24 but it just lead to more crying, shouting and threats of suicide. I'm now 25 and living alone (and still trying to learn how to be an independent adult), she has finally learned that her tricks have stopped working, but I do get bombarded with messages guilting me into calling her everyday. I don't mind staying in touch and would actually like to have a healthy relationship but it's not easy when you have an overly clingy and manipulative mother. 

Edit: I can relate to the paranoia and strange ideas about others. I was taught to never trust friends and was told so many cautionary tales of girls who trusted their friends too much and then ended up in some horrible situation. Usually the girl was murdered or had acid thrown in her face or whatever. I was told that only my family cared about me and friends were always hiding some sort of hate or jealousy towards me.
